Inasmuch as the County of San Diego has not yet identified all prospective site-specific projects which could potentially be funded under the Residential Rehabilitation Loan Program of the Community Development Block Grant Program, and to ensure that, pursuant to 36 CFR 800.4(a); all properties included in or potentially eligible for inclusion in the National Register of Historic Places are properly identified, the following shall apply:
1. The County of San Diego need conduct cultural resource surveys only for site-specific projects.
'2. When these projects have been clearly identified, the County of San Diego shall, in consultation with the State Historic Preservation Officer, establish a given project's area of potential environmental impact and shall, with the assistance of the State Historic Preservation Officer, formulate the particulars of an appropriate survey program for the specified project site. 
3. If rehabilitation activities on a specific site are or may become a segment of or will facilitate another undertaking which does not involve federal assistance or which involves the assistance of a federal agency other than the Department of Housing and Urban Development, the County of San Diego shall so inform the State Historic Preservation Officer at the earliest possible opportunity.
4. If properties included in or potentially eligible for inclusion in the National Register of Mistoric Places are identified as a result of survey activity, the County of San Diego shall, in timely fashion and in consultation with the State Historic Preservation Officer, apply the National Register Criteria set forth in 36 CFR 800.10 to the identified properties.
or if there is disagreement in this respect, the County of San Diego shall request in writing an opinion as to eligibility from the Director, Office of Archeology and Historic Preservation, National Park Service, Department of the Interior, Washington, D.C., 20246 in accordance with procedures set forth in 36 CFR 63. If the property is determined to be eligible, the County of San Diego shall comply with Section 106 of the Mational Historic Preservation Act of 1966 as amended by implementing 36 CFR 800  "Advisory Council Procedures For The Preservation and Protection of Historic Cultural Properties".
